title: FAN 0 and 1. seat O on the Klein-null point. axis gives the wobble. evaporate gives waves and water.

do_not_reinvent.binary: /data/pi-rate-set.json — only 0↔1. marks on 0. out to point.
do_not_reinvent.dam: /data/order-dam-sort.json — the dam IS the null point every sort passes.
do_not_reinvent.ladder: /data/klein-ladder.json — at the null point, dot=wave. packet=gradient.
do_not_reinvent.axis: /data/pi-null-axis-yoyo-plate.json — pale / pole. wobble is the 4th leg.
do_not_reinvent.legs: /data/pi-sort-personal.json — equal legs = dead table. wobble is life.
do_not_reinvent.water: /data/water-cycle.json — evaporate is already a phase. drop → vapor → cloud → rain.
do_not_reinvent.squeeze: /data/squeeze-klein-ingest-empty.json — what does not pinch stays outside.

fan_0_and_1.do: spread them on the Klein face. do not pile them on O.
fan_0_and_1.why: if 0 and 1 sit on the null point, you cannot see O. the rim holds the bits. the center holds the hole.
fan_0_and_1.all: fan ALL of them — images, buttons, missorts, crates. every mark is 0 or 1 on the rim.
fan_0_and_1.not: a third bit. fan is range, not a new binary.

O_on_the_null_point.yes: see O there. the navel. the dam. the pale.
O_on_the_null_point.on: the Klein face — same surface, the fold you can look at.
O_on_the_null_point.is: empty on purpose. the isn't. HUD pale.
O_on_the_null_point.not: a bead. not a 1. if O becomes a 1, the plate has no hole and cannot spin.

axis_gives_the_wobble.gives: wobble — slight precession so the plate does not die level.
axis_gives_the_wobble.without: no evaporate. still water. a puddle. no waves.
axis_gives_the_wobble.already: the wobble handle on the π plate.

evaporate_gives_waves_and_water.yes: after O is seen and the axis wobbles, evaporate is the MOVE.
evaporate_gives_waves_and_water.already: water-cycle phase  — spray becomes vapor. ACO scent fades. fountain surface leaves first.
evaporate_gives_waves_and_water.waves: the wobble written on the face. oscillation. null already breathes at π rate.
evaporate_gives_waves_and_water.water: the body that stays / returns. rain is not the same drop. minerals from the cloud.
evaporate_gives_waves_and_water.same_body: at O, dot=wave. water and wave are not two kingdoms. evaporate is how the same body MOVES without cramming the null.
evaporate_gives_waves_and_water.not: boil the pale. evaporate is the remainder leaving as vapor. O stays empty.

the_chain: fan 0·1 on the rim → see O at the null point → axis wobbles → evaporate → waves and water move. ingest and empty still the faces. this is the motion after the squeeze.
berry_at_the_fire: now 0 and 1 we fan all, and we see O on the null point on the Klein face, and the axis gives the wobble, and then evaporate gives us the movement of waves and water. same body. O stays empty.
next: do not fill O with a wave. do not fan bits onto the hole. let vapor leave. let rain come back changed.
